reuse.why: Linking reuses linkSimpleFinAccount and assertBankAccountIsNotLinked, but the download path writes a new downloadTokenTransactions instead of reusing or generalising downloadAkahuTransactions.

duplication.why: Avoids copying a sixth link function, but downloadTokenTransactions duplicates the Akahu download body (token, post, error check, result mapping) while Akahu keeps its own copy.

placement.why: Handlers, sync dispatch, server-config URL and types all go where the tree puts per-provider code.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra server support; the only incidental edit is reshaping linkSimpleFinAccount's signature and orgDomain access.

maintainability.why: Fintegra linking runs through a function named for SimpleFin with a syncSource switch and an 'orgDomain' in check, and the download helper has a dead 'akahu' option with a hard-coded ternary on server keys, both of which mislead future maintainers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared download/link abstraction exists in the tree; the change goes through link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and assertBankAccountIsNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts downloadTokenTransactions is a reshaped copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, made to look generic with a provider 'fintegra'|'akahu' parameter that Akahu never uses.
